proof_body:
by
  intro R _ a
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
    simp
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (a : ℕ → R), (1 - PowerSeries.X) * PowerSeries.mk a = PowerSeries.C (a 0) + PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.mk (fun n => a (n + 1) - a n)
